stem:
Rohit has a small handful of rice mixed with a few small pebbles. The pebbles differ in size, colour, and shape from the rice grains, and he can pick them out by hand.

Is handpicking suitable for this sample?

options.text: Yes, because the pebbles differ from the rice and can be picked out by hand in this small sample.
No, handpicking is unsuitable for any solid mixture that contains rice.
Yes, but only if the pebbles look identical to the rice in size and colour.
No, because handpicking never works when pieces differ in colour.

teacher.key_rationale: Handpicking suits a small solid mixture when components differ enough to pick out by hand. It is not barred for every rice mixture, and difference in size, colour, or shape is what makes picking possible.
